title: Keep product documentation reachable during change review
preconditions: A comparison has a matching pull-request review and current product documentation.

steps.action: Open the Review side for the selected comparison.
steps.expected_result: The matching review and change views appear inside the application shell.

steps.action: Navigate from Review to the corresponding Documentation entry.
steps.expected_result: The current product context remains reachable without changing or fabricating the selected comparison.

expected_result: Pass when review context and product documentation remain linked but distinct; fail if opening Review hides lasting context or mutates the comparison.
